repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN 是一款跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）的图形化客户端，支持 Xray、sing-box 等多种代理核心。提供直观的用户界面，简化了代理配置与管理流程，适用于需要稳定翻墙或网络加速的用户。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client for Windows, Linux, and macOS, supporting multiple proxy cores including Xray and sing-box. It offers an intuitive interface to simplify configuration and management of network proxies for enhanced connectivity.

repos.description: A fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the internet.
repos.summary_zh: frp 是一款高性能反向代理工具，专为穿透 NAT 或防火墙设计，支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议转发，提供 P2P 连接模式。具备多协议支持、自定义域名访问内网服务、SSH 穿透、HTTP 文件服务器暴露、HTTPS 加密转发、私有服务暴露、Prometheus 监控、客户端认证等核心功能，适用于远程开发、内网服务访问、IoT 设备连接等场景。
repos.summary_en: frp is a high-performance reverse proxy designed to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, with P2P connectivity. Key features include multi-protocol forwarding, custom domain access to internal services, SSH tunneling, HTTP file server exposure, HTTPS encryption, private service exposure, Prometheus monitoring, and client authentication, ideal for remote development and IoT access.

repos.description: A shadowsocks client for Android
repos.summary_zh: Shadowsocks Android 是一款基于 Kotlin 开发的开源代理客户端，支持 Android 和 Chrome OS 平台。该应用提供安全、快速的科学上网功能，采用 Shadowsocks 协议加密传输数据，兼容多种服务器配置，具备自动切换、流量统计等实用功能，适用于需要隐私保护和网络访问的场景。
repos.summary_en: Shadowsocks Android is an open-source proxy client built with Kotlin for Android and Chrome OS. It enables secure and fast internet access using the Shadowsocks protocol, supporting multiple server configurations, automatic switching, and traffic monitoring for enhanced privacy and network freedom.

repos.description: A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: FlClash 是一款基于 ClashMeta 的多平台代理客户端，支持 Android、Windows、macOS 和 Linux，具备 Material You 设计、深色模式、WebDAV 数据同步及订阅链接管理功能，界面简洁无广告，适用于需要跨平台网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: FlClash is a multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta, supporting Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features Material You design, dark mode, WebDAV sync, subscription management, and an ad-free, open-source interface for seamless cross-device proxy control.

repos.description: A proxy tool to bypass GFW.
repos.summary_zh: XX-Net 是一款运行9年的成熟翻墙工具，支持全平台多设备同时使用。其核心优势在于独创的流量混淆技术，能完美模拟Chrome浏览器行为，实现隐身级网络穿透。软件内置ChatGPT服务，提供百万级token额度，兼具隐私保护与AI生产力工具属性。
repos.summary_en: XX-Net is a mature 9-year-old circumvention tool supporting multi-platform simultaneous connections. Its core strength lies in proprietary traffic obfuscation that mimics Chrome browser behavior for stealthy network bypass. The software integrates built-in ChatGPT with one million free tokens per plan, combining privacy protection with AI productivity features.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

repos.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
repos.summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
repos.summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

repos.description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

repos.description: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

repos.description: Python ProxyPool for web spider
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

repos.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.
repos.summary_zh: Clash Party 是一款基于 Electron 的 Mihomo（Clash Meta）图形界面客户端，提供开箱即用的代理管理工具。支持 Smart Core 智能节点选择、多主题 UI、WebDAV 配置备份、Sub-Store 订阅集成及内核切换，简化了复杂代理配置流程，适合需要高效网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: Clash Party is an Electron-based GUI for Mihomo (Clash Meta) that offers an out-of-the-box proxy management tool. It features Smart Core AI-driven node selection, multi-theme UI, WebDAV config backup, Sub-Store integration, and dual-core support, streamlining complex proxy configurations for end users.

repos.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
repos.summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP 是一款功能强大的 IP 工具箱，支持多维度网络检测与隐私分析。核心功能包括：实时 IP 信息查询、WebRTC 连接检测、DNS 泄漏测试、全球节点延迟与 MTR 测试、网站可用性检查、代理规则验证及网络安全清单（258项）。支持 PWA 桌面应用、暗黑模式、键盘快捷键和多语言界面，适用于网络诊断、隐私保护和跨境访问测试。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is a comprehensive IP toolbox offering multi-dimensional network diagnostics and privacy analysis. Key features include real-time IP information lookup, WebRTC connection detection, DNS leak testing, global latency/MTR tests, website availability checks, proxy rule validation, and a 258-item cybersecurity checklist. It supports PWA desktop apps, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts, and multi-language interfaces for network troubleshooting, privacy protection, and cross-border access testing.

repos.description: proxychains ng (new generation) - a preloader which hooks calls to sockets in dynamically linked programs and redirects it through one or more socks/http proxies. continuation of the unmaintained proxychains project. the sf.net page is currently not updated, use releases from github release page instead.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyChains-NG 是原 proxychains 项目的现代化延续，通过 LD_PRELOAD 技术劫持动态链接程序的 socket 调用，强制流量经 SOCKS4/5 或 HTTP 代理转发。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 等主流平台，具备 IPv6、DNAT、多线程优化等特性，适用于绕过网络限制的场景，但需谨慎使用以避免法律风险。
repos.summary_en: ProxyChains-NG is a modern successor to the original proxychains project, intercepting socket calls in dynamically linked programs via LD_PRELOAD to route traffic through SOCKS4/5 or HTTP proxies. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and other platforms, featuring IPv6, DNAT, and multithreading optimizations. Designed for bypassing network restrictions, it requires careful configuration and legal awareness.

repos.description: HTTP proxy written in Go. COW can automatically identify blocked sites and use parent proxies to access.
repos.summary_zh: COW 是一个基于 Go 编写的智能 HTTP 代理工具，专为简化科学上网设计。它能自动识别被墙网站并仅对这些网站启用二级代理（如 Shadowsocks、SOCKS5 等），直连网站则绕过代理以提升访问速度。支持多类型二级代理、负载均衡、PAC 自动配置及访问行为学习，适用于移动设备或 APN 代理场景。
repos.summary_en: COW (Climb Over the Wall) is an intelligent HTTP proxy written in Go, designed to simplify bypassing internet restrictions. It automatically detects blocked websites and routes only those through secondary proxies (e.g., Shadowsocks, SOCKS5), while allowing direct access to uncensored sites for optimal speed. Features include multi-proxy support, load balancing, PAC generation, and adaptive learning of site accessibility patterns.

repos.description: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
repos.summary_zh: Aggregator 是一个高效免费的代理池构建工具，支持从 Telegram、GitHub 等多平台爬取代理资源，自动验证质量并转换为 Clash、V2Ray 等格式，提供 GitHub Gist 等灵活存储后端，适用于个人及企业级代理订阅管理。
repos.summary_en: Aggregator is a powerful free proxy pool builder that crawls proxy resources from multiple platforms like Telegram and GitHub, automatically validates quality, and converts them into formats such as Clash and V2Ray. It supports flexible storage backends like GitHub Gist and is ideal for personal and enterprise proxy subscription management.

repos.description: Multi-channel AI proxy with intelligent key rotation. 智能密钥轮询的多渠道 AI 代理。
repos.summary_zh: GPT-Load 是一个高性能企业级 AI API 透明代理服务，专为需要集成多 AI 服务的开发者和企业设计。基于 Go 构建，具备智能密钥轮询、负载均衡、故障自动恢复、动态配置热重载等特性，支持 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 等多种 AI 服务格式，提供完整的监控和管理界面。
repos.summary_en: GPT-Load is a high-performance, enterprise-grade transparent proxy service for AI APIs, designed for developers and enterprises integrating multiple AI services. Built with Go, it features intelligent key rotation, load balancing, automatic failure recovery, hot-reload configuration, and comprehensive monitoring. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs with a Vue 3 management interface.

repos.description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

repos.description: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
repos.summary_zh: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
repos.summary_en: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

repos.description: One Worker, All Subscriptions
repos.summary_zh: Sublink Worker 是一个轻量级订阅转换与管理工具，支持 ShadowSocks、VLESS、Hysteria2 等主流代理协议，兼容 Sing-Box、Clash 等客户端。通过 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 或 Docker 一键部署，提供 KV 存储的短链生成、多语言界面及自动化 API，适用于个人或团队统一管理多源代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: Sublink Worker is a lightweight subscription converter and manager supporting proxy protocols like ShadowSocks, VLESS, and Hysteria2. Deployable on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker, it offers short-link generation via KV storage, multi-language UI, and automation APIs for unified management of proxy subscriptions across clients such as Sing-Box and Clash.

repos.description: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
repos.summary_zh: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

repos.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
repos.summary_zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
repos.summary_en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

repos.description: Yet Another Clash Dashboard
repos.summary_zh: yacd 是一个现代化的 Clash 代理控制面板，提供简洁直观的 Web 界面用于管理代理规则、流量监控和配置。支持通过 URL 参数动态连接不同 Clash 后端实例，具备深色/浅色主题切换功能，可通过 Docker 快速部署，适用于个人或企业网络代理管理场景。
repos.summary_en: Yet Another Clash Dashboard (yacd) is a modern, clean web interface for managing Clash proxy configurations. It enables real-time traffic monitoring, rule management, and dynamic backend connection via URL parameters. Features include dark/light theme support and easy deployment via Docker, ideal for personal or enterprise proxy administration.

repos.description: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.
repos.summary_zh: DS2API 是一个高性能 DeepSeek Web 对话能力转换 API，支持 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容接口。采用 Go 全量实现后端，React 构建管理后台，具备多账号轮询、PoW 验证、Tool Calling 防泄漏处理等核心功能，支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，并提供完整的后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: DS2API is a high-performance API that converts DeepSeek Web chat capabilities into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini compatible interfaces. Built with full Go backend implementation and React admin UI, it features multi-account polling, PoW verification, Tool Calling protection, and supports deployment via Docker/Vercel. Includes complete management system with account testing and configuration sync.

repos.description: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR for Windows 是一款基于 ShadowsocksR 协议的跨平台代理工具，专为绕过网络审查设计。支持多服务器配置、系统级代理、PAC自动更新及UDP流量转发，提供完整的隐私保护和网络访问解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR for Windows is a cross-platform proxy tool based on the ShadowsocksR protocol, designed to bypass internet censorship. It supports multiple server configurations, system-wide proxy, automatic PAC updates, and UDP forwarding, offering comprehensive privacy protection and network access.

repos.description: IPProxyPool代理池项目，提供代理ip
repos.summary_zh: IPProxyPool是一个开源代理IP池项目，支持Python 2/3，提供高匿、匿名和透明代理IP抓取与验证服务。通过多线程爬虫自动采集代理源，结合评分机制筛选可用IP，支持HTTP/HTTPS协议及国内外地域过滤。项目采用SQLite默认数据库，可扩展至MySQL、MongoDB等，并提供RESTful API供外部调用，适用于爬虫、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: IPProxyPool is an open-source proxy IP pool project supporting Python 2/3, offering automated collection and validation of anonymous, high-anonymity, and transparent proxy IPs. It uses multi-threaded crawlers to gather proxies from multiple sources, filters them via a scoring system, and supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols with geographic filtering. Built on SQLAlchemy ORM, it defaults to SQLite but can be extended to MySQL or MongoDB. A RESTful API enables external access for use in web scraping and data collection applications.

repos.description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

repos.description: Free anti fingerprint browser, 指纹浏览器, 隐私浏览器, 防识别浏览器, 反识别浏览器, 防关联浏览器, 免费的web3空投专用指纹浏览器 https://virtualbrowser.cc/?src=github
repos.summary_zh: VirtualBrowser 是一款基于 Chromium 的免费反指纹浏览器，支持多环境隔离与指纹定制，可修改操作系统、代理、语言、时区等数十项指纹特征，适用于 Web3 空投防关联场景。提供自动化接口，支持 Playwright 集成，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
repos.summary_en: VirtualBrowser is a free anti-fingerprint browser based on Chromium, enabling multi-environment isolation and customizable fingerprinting. It allows modification of OS, proxy, language, timezone, and over 15+ fingerprint attributes for Web3 airdrop protection. Supports automation via Playwright and offers cross-platform expansion plans.

repos.description: AList proxy server for TvBox, support playlist and search.
repos.summary_zh: AList-TvBox 是一个专为 TvBox 设计的 AList 代理服务器，支持播放列表生成与内容搜索功能。通过集成 AList 的文件管理能力，为电视盒子提供结构化视频资源访问接口，适用于家庭媒体中心场景。
repos.summary_en: AList-TvBox is an AList proxy server tailored for TvBox, enabling playlist generation and content search. It leverages AList's file management to deliver structured video resources to TV boxes, ideal for home media center setups.

repos.description: gfw_whitelist
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供基于白名单的PAC代理配置方案，通过维护国内常用域名白名单，实现国内网站直连、境外网站走代理的科学上网模式。支持自动生成whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac三种格式的代理配置文件，兼容Chrome、Firefox等主流浏览器，支持SOCKS5/HTTPS等多种代理协议，并提供在线PAC生成服务。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a PAC proxy configuration solution based on whitelisting, allowing direct connection for domestic websites and proxy for international sites. It supports generating three types of proxy config files (whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac), compatible with major browsers, supporting multiple proxy protocols like SOCKS5/HTTPS, and offers online PAC generation service.

repos.description: python ip proxy tool  scrapy crawl. 抓取大量免费代理 ip，提取有效 ip 使用
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Scrapy 的 Python 代理 IP 抓取与验证工具，支持多源采集、异步验证、MySQL 存储及 RESTful 数据接口，提供高匿/匿名/透明代理筛选与 HTTPS 支持检测，适用于爬虫反爬、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: A Python-based proxy IP crawler and validator using Scrapy, featuring multi-source scraping, asynchronous validation, MySQL storage, and RESTful API for filtering proxies by anonymity and HTTPS support, ideal for web scraping and anti-bot bypass.

repos.description: A proxy node pool management tool based on sing-box, supporting multiple protocols, automatic failover and load balancing.  基于 sing-box 的代理节点池管理工具，支持多协议、多节点自动故障转移和负载均衡。
repos.summary_zh: Easy Proxies 是基于 sing-box 的代理节点池管理工具，支持多协议（VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2等）节点统一管理，提供自动故障转移、负载均衡和健康检查。具备 Web 控制面板和 API 接口，支持节点订阅、配置热更新及 DNS 解析优化，适用于构建高可用代理入口。
repos.summary_en: Easy Proxies is a sing-box-based proxy pool manager supporting multiple protocols (VMess, VLESS, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, etc.) with automatic failover, load balancing, and health checks. It features a web dashboard, RESTful API, subscription management, hot-reload configuration, and configurable DNS resolution for stable proxy access.

repos.description: ✨ 现代化代理订阅管理平台 | 智能分类 · 专业测速 · 链式中转 · 流量监控 · TG管理 · JS扩展 | Go+React 全新UI 🌍 Modern Proxy Subscription Manager | Smart Tags · Speed Test · Relays · Monitor · TG Bot · JS Scripts
repos.summary_zh: SublinkPro 是一款现代化代理订阅管理平台，基于 Go+React 构建，支持智能标签自动分类、链式代理中转、专业测速及 Telegram 远程管理。具备 AI 模板编辑、机场流量监控、分组排序等高级功能，提供 Docker 部署与移动端友好界面，适用于个人开发者与机场运营场景。
repos.summary_en: SublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management platform built with Go+React, featuring intelligent tag auto-classification, chain proxy routing, professional speed testing, and Telegram remote control. It supports AI-powered template editing, airport traffic monitoring, group-based node sorting, and offers Docker deployment with mobile-friendly UI for personal and commercial use.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个多服务注册与API密钥管理工具，专注于自动化注册并验证Tavily、Firecrawl和Exa的API密钥。通过真实浏览器模拟注册流程、集成Turnstile验证码破解、自动收取邮箱验证码，并对获取的密钥进行实际调用验证，确保可用性。支持跨平台运行，可选将密钥上传至统一代理池，专为MySearch-Proxy等聚合搜索网关提供稳定可靠的密钥上游来源。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a multi-service toolkit for automating registration and validation of API keys from Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It simulates real browser signups, integrates Turnstile solver, auto-collects email verification codes, and validates keys via live API calls to ensure functionality. Cross-platform compatible, with optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for aggregation search gateways like MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: 毒奶博主的自用机场推荐——150GB/14元/月起，Vless/AnyTLS协议支持，透传，IEPL专线加持，稳定低延迟，ChatGPT 等AI工具支持，Netflix等主流流媒体区域限制解锁；
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为博主自用机场推荐，主打高性价比代理服务。核心产品包括FlyingBird（SS协议）和一云梯（Trojan协议），均提供100GB起/15元月付套餐，支持IEPL专线、ChatGPT及Netflix等流媒体解锁，具备季付9折、半年85折、年付8折优惠。所有机场均经过长期稳定性测试，适合追求低延迟与稳定连接的用户。
repos.summary_en: This repository recommends affordable proxy services for personal use. Key offerings include FlyingBird (SS protocol) and 1YunTi (Trojan), both starting at 100GB/¥15/month with IEPL专线, ChatGPT, and Netflix streaming unlock. Discounts: 10% off quarterly, 15% off semi-annually, 20% off annually. All providers are tested for stability and low latency, ideal for reliable overseas access.

repos.description: 让 QwenLM 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: Qwen-Proxy 是一个将通义千问官方平台（chat.qwen.ai、Qwen Code/CLI）转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口的代理服务，支持多账户轮询、流式响应、多模态及256K长上下文。通过统一API格式，用户可无缝对接各类OpenAI客户端调用通义千问模型，并提供Web管理界面与代理池集成方案应对高并发限速问题。
repos.summary_en: Qwen-Proxy is a proxy service that converts QwenLM's official platforms (chat.qwen.ai, Qwen Code/CLI) into OpenAI-compatible APIs. It supports multi-account polling, streaming responses, multimodal capabilities, and 256K context via CLI endpoints. Seamlessly integrates with OpenAI clients while offering a web admin interface and proxy pool integration for high-concurrency scenarios.

repos.description: 基于chatgpt-next-web，增加了midjourney绘画功能，支持mj-plus的ai换脸和局部重绘，接入了stable-diffusion，支持oss，支持接入fastgpt知识库，支持suno，支持luma。支持dall-e-3、gpt-4-vision-preview、whisper、tts等多模态模型，支持gpt-4-all，支持GPTs商店。新增加了支持后台管理的版本，包括登录注册，平台模型apikey管理，套餐管理，消息保存等。
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro 是基于 ChatGPT-Next-Web 的深度增强版本，集成多模态 AI 能力，支持 MidJourney 绘画、Stable Diffusion、DALL-E-3、Suno 音乐生成、Luma 视频创作及 GPTs 商店，同时提供无后台轻量版与带用户管理、API 密钥管控、套餐订阅的有后台企业版，覆盖绘图、语音、文件解析等全场景 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro is an enhanced fork of ChatGPT-Next-Web, integrating multimodal AI capabilities including MidJourney painting, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E-3, Suno music generation, Luma video creation, and GPTs Store. It offers both a lightweight 'no-backend' version and a full-featured 'with-backend' enterprise edition with user management, API key control, subscription plans, and support for file parsing, OCR, TTS, and cloud storage.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-iOS
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 Shadowsocks 的下一代 macOS 客户端，提供高性能代理功能，支持 SSR 协议，适用于科学上网与隐私保护。项目因监管要求已停止维护，原代码存档于 shadowsocksr-backup 仓库。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, offering high-performance proxy capabilities with SSR protocol support for secure browsing and privacy protection. The project has been discontinued due to regulatory reasons, with archived code in the shadowsocksr-backup repository.

repos.description: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
repos.summary_zh: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
repos.summary_en: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

repos.summary_zh: Shadowsocks 是一个高性能的 TCP/UDP 隧道代理工具，支持用户管理 API、TCP Fast Open 和 IP 黑名单，用于绕过网络防火墙，提供跨平台服务端与客户端支持，适用于 Linux、Windows、Android 及 OpenWRT 等环境。
repos.summary_en: Shadowsocks is a high-performance TCP/UDP tunnel proxy with features like user management API, TCP Fast Open, and IP blacklisting, designed to bypass firewalls. It supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, Windows, Android, and OpenWRT, offering both server and client implementations.

repos.description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
repos.summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

repos.description: 基于 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建、由 mihomo 驱动的原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，专注轻量、稳定与可观测。
repos.summary_zh: ClashBar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 mihomo Core，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建。主打轻量化设计（37.5MB），支持配置管理、节点切换、流量策略控制、实时连接监控与系统代理集成，提供中英文双语界面，专注提升代理工具在 macOS 上的易用性与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar proxy client built with SwiftUI + AppKit, powered by mihomo Core. It emphasizes lightweight design (37.5MB), offering configuration management, node switching, traffic policy control, real-time connection monitoring, and system proxy integration. With bilingual support (zh/en), it enhances usability and stability for proxy tools on macOS.

repos.description: 一站式Exa注册机+号池轮询+API服务反代+多用户管理
repos.summary_zh: ExaFree 是一个 Exa API 代理与管理平台，支持多账号轮询、用户级 API Key 管理、Linux DO OAuth2 登录注册。提供完整的 API 代理服务（search/answer/contents 等）、MCP 工具集成、管理面板及数据库备份功能，采用 Docker 部署，支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL 持久化存储。
repos.summary_en: ExaFree is an Exa API proxy and management platform supporting multi-account polling, user-level API key management, and Linux DO OAuth2 login/registration. It provides full API proxy services (search/answer/contents), MCP tool integration, admin panel, and database backup features via Docker with SQLite/PostgreSQL support.

repos.description: ProxyLLM是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话把多种 LLM网站的能力统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API, 一键应用到Claude Code (ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that captures browser sessions to unify the capabilities of multiple LLM websites into an OpenAI-compatible API, enabling one-click integration with Claude Code)
repos.summary_zh: ProxyLLM 是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等多平台 LLM 服务统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持一键集成 Claude Code。具备多站点管理、凭据自动捕获、OAuth 登录、动态模型发现及本地持久化日志等功能，提供完整的 OpenAI 格式接口与 Anthropic 原生 API 支持。
repos.summary_en: ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that unifies multiple LLM platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) into an OpenAI-compatible API by capturing browser sessions. It enables one-click integration with Claude Code, featuring multi-site management, automatic credential capture, OAuth login, dynamic model discovery, and local persistence, exposing both OpenAI-style and native Anthropic APIs.

repos.description: A ShadowsocksR client for Android4.0+.Compatible Shadowsocks protocol and support some ShadowsocksR function.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR Droid 是一款专为 Android 4.0+ 设备设计的 ShadowsocksR 客户端，兼容 Shadowsocks 协议并支持部分 ShadowsocksR 功能，采用 Kotlin 和 Java 开发，提供跨平台网络代理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR Droid is an Android 4.0+ client for ShadowsocksR, compatible with Shadowsocks protocol and supporting some ShadowsocksR features. Built with Kotlin and Java, it offers a cross-platform network proxy solution for enhanced privacy and access.

repos.description: Clash X
repos.summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
repos.summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

repos.description: 面向开发者与 AI Agent 的开源流量调试工作台，让业务异常可筛选、调试修改可追溯、排查现场可分享。
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: ⚠️ 封号风控升级，请勿大量使用 / High ban risk, personal testing only 🚨 Use at your own risk.
repos.summary_zh: Kiro Stack 是一个将 Amazon Kiro（原 Q Developer）账号转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 的代理系统，结合 kiro-go 的管理面板与 kiro-gateway 的稳定转发能力，支持多账号池、自动 Token 刷新和双端点容错，适用于 Cursor、Claude Code 等 IDE 集成。
repos.summary_en: Kiro Stack is a proxy system that converts Amazon Kiro (formerly Q Developer) accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It combines kiro-go's web admin panel with kiro-gateway's stable request handling, featuring multi-account pools, auto-token refresh, and dual-endpoint fallback for use in IDEs like Cursor and Claude Code.

repos.description: 节点过滤器
repos.summary_zh: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

repos.description: 让 Z.ai Chat 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: zai-proxy 是一个 Go 语言开发的代理服务，将 z.ai 网页聊天接口转换为 OpenAI API 和 Anthropic Messages API 兼容格式。支持 GLM 及 Claude 模型自动映射、流式响应、多模态输入、函数调用、联网搜索等高级功能，提供匿名 token 免登录访问，支持 Docker 部署和自定义代理池配置。
repos.summary_en: zai-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that transforms z.ai web chat into OpenAI and Anthropic API-compatible formats. It supports model mapping (GLM/Claude), streaming responses, multimodal inputs, function calling, search mode, anonymous access, Docker deployment, and custom proxy pools for enhanced reliability.

repos.description: OpenAI中转
repos.summary_zh: 本项目将 Cursor 编辑器的 AI 能力转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，支持通过 Bearer Token 认证调用聊天补全功能。用户只需提供 WorkosCursorSessionToken 即可在其他应用中复用 Cursor 的 AI 服务，适用于集成开发、自动化脚本等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project converts Cursor editor's AI capabilities into an OpenAI-compatible API interface, enabling reuse of Cursor's AI functionality in other applications. It supports chat completion via Bearer Token authentication using WorkosCursorSessionToken, ideal for integration and automation use cases.

repos.summary_zh: zed2api 是一个轻量级本地服务器，将 Zed 编辑器中的 LLM API 代理为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口。支持多模型供应商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI）、SSE 流式输出、OAuth 登录及内嵌 Web UI，提供账号管理、自动故障转移和 HTTPS 代理支持，编译为单文件二进制，跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: zed2api is a lightweight local server that proxies LLM APIs from Zed editor into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. It supports multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI), SSE streaming, OAuth login, embedded Web UI, account management, failover, and HTTPS proxying. Compiled as a single binary with cross-platform support.

repos.description: 让 Grok Chat 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: grok-proxy 是一个基于 Go 的代理服务，将 Grok Chat 网页接口转换为 OpenAI API 兼容格式，支持流式/非流式响应、多模态图片输入、联网搜索及思考模式。用户通过 SSO Cookie 认证调用，支持 SOCKS5 代理池轮询，提供 Docker 快速部署和自定义配置能力。
repos.summary_en: grok-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that converts Grok Chat's web interface into an OpenAI API-compatible format. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, multimodal image input, web search, and reasoning mode. Authentication via SSO cookie, with optional SOCKS5 proxy pool rotation. Offers Docker deployment, model selection, and custom configuration via environment variables.

repos.description: singbox-nodejs
repos.summary_zh: singbox-nodejs 是一个基于 Sing-Box 内核的代理工具，支持单端口和多端口模式，集成 HY2、HTTP订阅、Argo、TUIC 和 REALITY 协议。用户可通过订阅链接访问，自动分配端口或手动配置 ports.txt 文件，部署简单无需修改代码。
repos.summary_en: singbox-nodejs is a proxy tool based on the Sing-Box kernel, supporting single and multi-port modes with integrated protocols like HY2, HTTP subscription, Argo, TUIC, and REALITY. Accessible via subscription link, it auto-assigns ports or allows manual configuration in ports.txt, requiring no code modifications for deployment.

repos.description: 利用bpb漏洞获取免费的节点，cloudflareWorkers部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于BPB面板漏洞的免费节点生成工具，通过Cloudflare Workers实现自动化部署，支持一键获取免费节点，降低使用门槛，适合小白用户快速上手。
repos.summary_en: A free node generator exploiting BPB panel vulnerabilities, deployed via Cloudflare Workers for one-click access to nodes, enabling easy setup and continuous availability for users.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Grok AI 代理服务，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 和可视化 Web 管理界面，支持文本对话、多规格图片生成及视频创作，具备 Token 自动轮换、API Key 速率限制与一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A Cloudflare Workers-based proxy for Grok AI, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs and a web admin interface. Supports text chat, image/video generation with customizable ratios, token auto-rotation, rate limiting, and one-click deployment.

repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge 是一个专为 OpenCode 和 CherryStudio 设计的本地代理工具，通过 FastAPI + HTTP/2 中间层解决 AnyRouter API 的 WAF 拦截与 TLS 指纹检测问题，支持 Header 伪装、工具注入、流式透传及配置热重载，实现 Claude Code 客户端的无缝接入。
repos.summary_en: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge is a local proxy tool designed for OpenCode and CherryStudio, resolving WAF blocking and TLS fingerprint issues when accessing AnyRouter API via an HTTP/2-enabled FastAPI middleware. It supports header spoofing, tool injection, SSE streaming, and hot-reload configuration for seamless integration with Claude Code clients.

repos.description: A Proxy for Free Proxies [DOGE]
repos.summary_zh: autoproxy 是一个基于 Node.js 的本地 HTTPS 代理中继工具，自动从 free-proxy-list.net 抓取并筛选支持 Google 和 HTTPS 的公共代理，构建可信代理池。通过 CONNECT 隧道转发客户端请求，支持自动刷新与轮询调度，适用于学习与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: autoproxy is a local HTTPS proxy relay built in Node.js that fetches public proxies from free-proxy-list.net, filters for those supporting Google and HTTPS, and forwards CONNECT requests via a rotating upstream pool. Designed for learning and research, it auto-refreshes the proxy list and enables secure tunneling through trusted proxies.

repos.description: 基于 claude code sdk 的 agent api，兼容Skills + Sub Agents
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code SDK 的轻量级本地代理，提供 HTTP POST + SSE 流式接口，兼容 Skills 与 Sub Agents。支持会话持久化、历史查询及 Docker 部署，适用于 Worker/DO 统一调用 Anthropic 兼容 API。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight local proxy for Claude Agent SDK using TypeScript + Bun, offering HTTP POST + SSE streaming interface. Compatible with Skills and Sub Agents, supports session persistence, history retrieval, and Docker deployment for unified access to Anthropic-compatible APIs.

repos.description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.
repos.summary_zh: http-relay 是一个轻量级 HTTP 中继工具，支持将形如 /{absolute-url} 的请求转发至目标地址，支持代理配置与流量抓包功能，适用于调试、代理转发及流量分析场景。
repos.summary_en: http-relay is a lightweight HTTP relay tool that forwards requests in the format /{absolute-url} to target URLs, supporting proxy configuration and traffic dumping for debugging, proxying, and traffic analysis.

repos.description: 一站式 cpa痛点 管理工具
repos.summary_zh: API Center 是一款专为 CPA 场景设计的一站式管理工具，通过定时同步 CLI-Proxy 的使用数据至 SQLite 实现持久化统计，支持多维度使用量分析、站点签到、CodeX 账号管理、OpenCode 配置可视化及成本计算，显著提升模型调用效率与账号管理能力。
repos.summary_en: API Center is a one-stop management tool for CPA pain points, enabling persistent usage tracking via SQLite synchronization with CLI-Proxy. It offers multi-dimensional analytics, site check-ins, CodeX account validation, OpenCode configuration visualization, and cost calculation to optimize model utilization and account lifecycle management.

repos.summary_zh: 为 Clash Verge/Party 设计的智能分流脚本，支持节点清洗、流媒体加速、省流模式及TUN模式SSH直连修复。可自动屏蔽低质节点、建立专用媒体组，并配置国内网站直连与AI/流媒体强制走代理，显著提升代理效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: A smart routing script for Clash Verge/Party that cleans low-quality nodes, creates dedicated media groups, enforces streaming/AI traffic via premium proxies, enables data-saving mode, and fixes SSH direct connection in TUN mode by bypassing proxy for specified IPs/ports.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

repos.description: ClashRelay - Clash 链式代理配置生成器 | 支持 VMess/VLESS/Trojan/SS/Hysteria2 等协议解析
repos.summary_zh: RelayBox 是一款现代化的 Clash 配置转换工具，支持 VMess/VLESS/Trojan/SS/Hysteria2 等协议，提供中转链路规划、智能规则补充与订阅整理功能。通过可视化界面实现跳板节点级联、落地配置生成及规则冲突检测，一键导出可直接使用的 YAML 配置文件。
repos.summary_en: RelayBox is a modern Clash configuration converter supporting VMess/VLESS/Trojan/SS/Hysteria2 protocols. It enables relay chain planning, intelligent rule supplementation, and subscription management with visual node selection, automatic subgroup generation, and conflict detection for seamless YAML export.
